name: NXDATA-1 Bucharest (BUH1)
notes: 8 Dimitrie Pompeiu Blvd, Bucharest; Google Cloud Interconnect facility 'NXDATA-1 Bucharest Romania (BU1)'; 27,500 sqft raised floor, 2.5 MW power, ISO 27001/9001; densest interconnection/peering hub in SE Europe.

name: NXDATA-2 Bucharest (BUH2)
notes: 6-A Dimitrie Pompeiu Blvd (BOB Building, UpGround Complex), Sector 2; 1 MW power; NXDATA's second facility ~500 m from NXDATA-1; directory-listing evidence, verify on nxdata.ro for official confirmation.

name: GTS Telecom Bucharest Data Center (Calea Rahovei)
notes: Electromagnetica Business Park, Calea Rahovei 266-268; 2 MW max installed power, 240 racks; Uptime Tier III/TIA 942; original DC opened 2007 with subsequent expansion (Tema Energy completed DC 3.1 expansion in 2013).

name: Voxility IR2 (Dimitrie Pompeiu)
notes: Voxility IR2, Dimitrie Pompeiu Blvd, Bucharest; 1 MW datacenter initial extension on major fiber routes, designed for high-density AI workloads; 20 years of datacenter operations.

name: Portland Trust Bucharest DC2 (Preciziei)
notes: Building permit received for Portland Trust's first Bucharest data center on a plot in western Bucharest (Preciziei area, ~4 ha); Baxtel lists project with 2026 build; capacity claims of 20-30 MW unverified - needs PMB/sector AC record for A-grade confirmation.

name: Portland Trust Bucharest DC1 (Strada Releului)

name: Solidus Ai Tech Bucharest
notes: Carrier-neutral Bucharest site listed by Baxtel: first built 2025, expansions through 2026, 8 MW target; crypto/AI-token-backed operator (AITECH); needs operator page or local autorizatie de construire confirmation.

name: Kyndryl Bucharest
notes: Directory listing of Kyndryl Bucharest facility (Soseaua Orhideelor per methodology); enterprise/legacy IBM infrastructure; verify with Kyndryl or local records.

name: Orange Romania Bucharest data centers
developer: Orange Romania (legacy Telekom Romania Communications / NCC Balcan-IX)
notes: Orange Romania operates 7 large data centers (2 Bucharest, 2 Cluj, 2 Brasov, 1 Timisoara) per DataCenter Forum 2026 quote by Orange B2B director; Orange Business Services has 5 DCs in Bucharest/Cluj/Brasov after 2021 Telekom acquisition; Drumul Taberei legacy site; treat old Telekom/Romtelecom/NCC Balcan-IX listings as aliases (no double counting).

name: Cloudul Privat Guvernamental - Bucuresti node (STS)
notes: Government cloud (Cloudul Privat Guvernamental) node in Bucuresti; ADR states Cristian and Giroc nodes completed while Bucuresti and Sibiu are in completion status; design: two Tier IV + two Tier III across the 4 nodes.

developer: Ministerul Afacerilor Interne (DGCTI); built by Tema Energy
notes: Public-sector Tier 3 data center in Bucharest received in 2022 (1.5 MW per Panorama); Tema Energy case study quotes MAI DGCTI; large public facility not in commercial colo directories.

name: WhiteHat Rotunda
notes: WhiteHat operates 3 carrier-neutral data centers in Romania: Bucharest (Rosu), Braila (Strada Mare 14) and Rotunda (Bacau County); Rotunda has 5 networks and 2 exchanges connected per PeeringDB; directory-grade evidence, verify locally.

name: HZone Oradea Data Center
notes: Own data center in Oradea, Bihor, Calea Borsului - Industrial Park 1; enterprise equipment with full network/power/storage redundancy; company-operated since 2006.

name: Centrul Regional de Date Nord-Vest (Bistrita)
notes: Regional data center for the North-West development region (Bistrita-Nasaud, Bihor, Cluj, Maramures, Salaj, Satu Mare); STS tender ~84 million lei (design & execution, Unirea zone near TeraPlast Arena, 18-month build); financing contract signed July 2026 - physical facility in Bistrita.

name: WhiteHat Braila (Strada Mare 14)
notes: One of WhiteHat's three Romanian data centers at Strada Mare 14, Braila; directory-grade evidence (datacenters.com); verify with operator/local records.

name: Cloudul Privat Guvernamental - STS Cristian node
notes: STS data center in Cristian, Brasov county hosts technical equipment for the dedicated government-cloud component (EUR 100m, installed Dec 2024); ADR confirms Cristian node completed; ANCPI hacked database was moved to this government cloud.

name: Orange Romania Brasov data centers
notes: Two large Orange data centers in Brasov per DataCenter Forum 2026 quote; Orange Business/legacy Telekom facility listed at Strada Mihail Sadoveanu 9, Brasov (datacenters.com); alias history: Telekom Romania Communications acquired by Orange 2021.

name: Zoar Online Buzau

name: Orange Romania Cluj-Napoca data centers
